# Shivraj Pet Clinic & Lab

> Multispecies veterinary clinic in Pimple Nilakh, Pune, India, serving Pimple Nilakh, Wakad, Pimple Saudagar, and Vishal Nagar since 2013. Father-son veterinary team (Dr. Pritesh Vidhate, Dr. Shivaji Vidhate) offering in-house pathology lab, digital X-ray, sonography, surgery, and a dedicated Exotic Animal Centre for birds, rabbits, turtles, guinea pigs, and hamsters. Consultation: ₹300 (regular), ₹400 (exotic pets). Open Mon–Tue and Thu–Sun, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM & 3:00–8:30 PM. Closed Wednesdays. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 77569 65169.

## Services

- [Preventive Medicine](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/preventive-medicine.html): Vaccination, deworming, wellness exams
- [Clinical Medicine](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/clinical-medicine.html): General consultations and diagnosis
- [Exotic Animal Centre](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/exotic-animal-centre.html): Birds, rabbits, turtles, guinea pigs, hamsters
- [Pathology Lab](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/pathology-lab.html): In-house blood tests, 15–20 minute results
- [Digital X-Ray](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/digital-xray.html): On-site digital radiography
- [Sonography](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/sonography.html): Ultrasound imaging
- [CT Scan & MRI](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/ct-scan-mri.html): Advanced imaging referrals
- [Dog Neutering](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/dog-neutering.html) / [Cat Spaying](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/cat-spaying.html)
- [Dog Tumor Surgery](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/dog-tumor-surgery.html)
- [Orthopedic Surgery](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/orthopedic-surgery.html)
- [Soft Tissue Surgery](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/soft-tissue-surgery.html)
- [Foreign Body Removal Surgery](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/foreign-body-removal-surgery.html)
- [Emergency Surgery](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/emergency-surgery.html)
- [Vet Pharmacy](https://www.shivrajpetclinicpune.com/services/vet-pharmacy.html)
